2034-4094-5220-6961-8347.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
2034-4094-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2

2872-4613-6857.easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Clever Conjurer is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2872-4613-6857.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2872-4613-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5332-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5332-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5332-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Carmen and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-856-2558-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
728-856-2558-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
2511-5220-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

4659-5086-5183-6824-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6824-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-2313-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Conclave Mentor
Repeat.

129-1409-6006-6791.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3457-7786.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2981-4694-7652.easyPrerequisites: Tom, Bert, and William is an artifact.
2981-4694-7652.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

891-2730-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-2363-3836-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1850-6620-6701.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-6620-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2933-3499-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1558-5131-6704.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.
You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1558-5131-6704.description:
Activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping Muldrotha, causing RMS TItanic to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to sacrifice it and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast RMS Titanic from your graveyard by paying {3}{R}.
Repeat each turn.

944-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3693-4029-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4029-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

81-791-2290.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
81-791-2290.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

2438-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1479-2374-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2232-5435-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
2232-5435-5659.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability from step 1.
Repeat.

222-629-997-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-997-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1308-2743-5461.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1308-2743-5461.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

1308-1645-1765-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-1636-2034-2242-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-2034-2242-4091.description:
Activate Elspeth's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

1608-2034-3008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1608-2034-3008.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Triplicate Titan.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Repeat.

877-2034-3184-4645.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The First Sliver, adding {C}{C}.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast The First Sliver for {0}.
Resolve the First Sliver's cascade ability.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

690-2200-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-2200-4658.description:
Activate Diamond Valley by tapping it and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1143-4277-4893.notablePrerequisites: Diviner's Wand attached to any creature you control.
1143-4277-4893.description:
Activate the creature with Diviner's Wand attached by paying {2}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat.

369-2961-4050.notablePrerequisites: False Demise attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2961-4050.description:
Sacrifice Iridescent Drake to Phyrexian Altar.
False Demise returns Iridescent Drake to the battlefield.
Iridescent Drake returns False Demise to the battlefield attached to itself.
Repeat.

1358-4740.description:
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing Aether Reservor to become a creature.
Activate Sydri's second ability by paying {W}{B}, granting Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink and deathtouch.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir, dealing 50 damage to a target of your choice and gaining 50 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1518-1987-4125-4714.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-4125-4714.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
